# L3 neutral interface

| name | direction | width | requirement |
|---|---|---|---|
| i_clk | input | 1 | mandatory fixed port name |
| i_reset | input | 1 | mandatory fixed port name |
| o_store_addr | output | 8 | (typical) address spelling; implemented names delegated |
| o_flag | output | 1 | mandatory fixed port name |

## Physical Pad Placement

One pad per bit. The south side has no signal ports.

| Side | Signals |
|---|---|
| West | `i_clk`, `i_reset` |
| East | o_store_addr[7:0] signals |
| North | `o_flag` |
| South | — |
